headline: Kino Polska TV group's profit down 20 percent. Although Zoom is growing strongly
summary: Kino Polska TV's capital group recorded a minimal decline in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, while net profit fell by one fifth. Zoom revenue grew strongly, according to preliminary data.
why: Kino Polska TV is a Polish pay-TV and media group, and its quarterly results show pressure on the country's traditional broadcast business.
